layout_strategies.general: Use generous spacing (md/lg) between sections to let content breathe. Embrace the 'Organic & Earthy' vibe by relying on soft, large border radii (24px for main cards).
layout_strategies.home_screen: Horizontal ScrollViews for Categories (Street Food vs Regular). Vertical FlatList for nearby vendors. Use large, immersive imagery for the street food carts.
layout_strategies.restaurant_detail: Parallax header with large image of the food. Sticky category tabs below the header. Cardless list for menu items with subtle 1px border separators.
layout_strategies.cart_checkout: Clean, distraction-free layout. High contrast Primary CTA pinned to the bottom of the screen (absolute positioning or flex end).

hero_banner.description: Authentic Indian street food platter, great for home screen header or 'Street Food' category hero.

category_samosa.description: Fried food (samosa/kachori vibe) for category thumbnails.

category_spices.description: Colorful display of spices, use for 'Explore Ingredients' or 'Local Flavors' banner.

delivery_tracking.description: Delivery man riding a motorcycle. Use on Order Tracking or Active Orders screen.

vendor_profile.description: Man standing in front of street food table, perfect for cart vendor profile picture.

icons.recommendation: Use Feather or Ionicons from @expo/vector-icons for clean, readable icons on mobile.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against the Burnt Orange (#E04D01) primary color is pure White (#FFFFFF) to meet APCA contrast ratios.
accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements must have a minimum hit area of 44x44 points. Use hitSlop on TouchableOpacity when the visual element is smaller.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid). E.g., `testID="login-form-submit-button"`

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native app. Do NOT use HTML/Tailwind classes (like div, p, mt-4). Use React Native components (View, Text, Image, ScrollView, FlatList) and StyleSheet.create().
Always apply testID (equivalent to data-testid) to TouchableOpacity, TextInput, and main View components for testing purposes.
Strictly follow the Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) color palette: #FAF7F2 background, #E04D01 primary. Avoid generic tech-blue.
Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Work Sans' for body text. Load them via expo-google-fonts.
Images MUST be pulled from the provided image_urls. Do NOT use placeholder domains like via.placeholder.com. Ensure external images use the URI property in Image component.
For shadows, use the exact shadow configurations provided in the design guidelines (combining shadowColor, offset, opacity, radius, and elevation).
Keep border radii large (24px) for cards to give a soft, approachable feel suitable for food.
Implement horizontal scroll lists for categories to save vertical space, avoiding basic vertical list stacking everywhere.
